svg.title: Two separating lines and the maximum-margin one
svg.desc: A small two-class data set, separable by a straight line. A dotted line separates it but passes very close to a few points. A solid line, the maximum-margin separator, sits midway between the classes with two dashed lines parallel to it touching the closest points of each class; those closest points, the support vectors, are circled.
svg.text: versus γ = 0.10 for the other line
